current_answer: As checked on October 29, 2026, Rockstar, Take-Two, PlayStation, and Xbox still list Grand Theft Auto VI for November 19, 2026 on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S. New reporting says review codes have begun going to media and reviews are expected November 18. This is a modest, unofficial signal of active launch operations, not proof that the game has gone gold, is fully certified, or cannot be delayed. No official native PC date or window has been announced.

catalogue_card.question: Do reported GTA 6 review codes make November 19 safer?
catalogue_card.text: The official console date is still November 19. Reports say review codes are circulating and reviews are expected November 18; Rockstar has not confirmed this, and review access is not proof the game is finished or the date guaranteed.

summary: Rockstar, Take-Two, PlayStation, and Xbox still list November 19, 2026 for PS5 and Xbox Series X|S. No new official date change was found.

NateTheHate2 posted that review codes had begun going to media and gave November 18 as the embargo date. Insider Gaming says it independently verified the November 18 review date and reports copies allegedly went out near the end of October. Neither is a first-party Rockstar or Take-Two announcement.

The report is a limited launch-operations signal if accurate. It does not establish that the game has gone gold, is final or fully certified, or cannot be delayed. Rockstar has moved the public target twice before.
No official native PC platform, date, or window has been announced. GamesBeat reports a Q1 2027 PC plan from four anonymous sources; it is not an official commitment.
Official PS5 Store pages show regional unlock times; the Xbox page lists November 19 but no hour. Rockstar Support says preload begins November 12, which is not the playable unlock.

The last detailed Cyberleek report said no new material appeared on the public list by October 22; the account, operator, and full-build claim remain unverified. See the October 25 report for the evidence review.
Take-Two scheduled fiscal Q2 2027 results for November 9. The event is a checkpoint, not evidence about release readiness or a promise to discuss GTA VI.
Analytics were unavailable. Pool visits, source checks, decisions, repeat use, and revenue remain unknown.
uncertainty: November 19 remains a public console commitment, not a delivery guarantee; two earlier target movements remain relevant.
The review-code and embargo claims are reported, not official. The direct code-distribution claim has no named recipient; Insider Gaming does not explain its independent verification.
Review access does not prove a gold, final, or fully certified build, and does not make another delay impossible.
The Q1 2027 PC window is an unconfirmed GamesBeat report from four anonymous sources.
Regional PS5 Store metadata may change and is not a publisher-wide global timing announcement; the checked Xbox page lists no exact hour.
The last specific Cyberleek report checked said no new material appeared by October 22. The account, operator, and full-build claim remain unverified.
The read-only analytics broker was unavailable; reader behavior and product value remain unknown.
